newsitem.title: CHILE: Snow-hit El Teniente copper pit output near normal.
newsitem.headline: Snow-hit El Teniente copper pit output near normal.

text.p: Copper production at Chilean state company Codelco's El Teniente mine has returned close to usual levels after heavy snow paralyzed the pit for five days last week, said a division spokesman Monday.
"We are operating at 95 percent of normal in all aspects," said spokesman Rodrigo Rivas.
Blizzards cut roads and railways to the mine and damaged equipment at the pit's concentrator.
The mine will know later this week how much production was lost in the bad weather, although preliminary figures showed losses to be around 5,000 tonnes, he said.
El Teniente, the second largest of Codelco's four mines, produced 345,000 tonnes of copper last year.
